items.title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers

items.title_en: Tech Workers Lose Faith in Careers Amid Burnout and Disillusionment
items.summary: An article exploring why tech workers are increasingly sad and disillusioned, prompting a rich discussion about burnout, industry shifts, and the toxicity of the online world.

items.title: Oracle bans AI-generated code from OpenJDK

items.title_en: Oracle Bans AI-Generated Code from OpenJDK Contributions
items.summary: Oracle's OpenJDK interim policy bans AI-generated code contributions, sparking discussion about copyright, provenance, and review burden.

items.title: Making Postgres 300x faster for analytics: batching, operator fusion, and SIMD

items.summary: The post explores making Postgres 300x faster for analytics via batching, operator fusion, and SIMD, detailing the pgrust query engine approach.

items.title: 2027 memory capacity is reportedly sold out
items.title_zh: 2027年内存产能据报道已售罄，AI需求推高HBM
items.title_en: 2027 Memory Capacity Reportedly Sold Out Amid AI HBM Demand
items.summary: Memory capacity for 2027 is reportedly sold out, largely due to AI demand for HBM consuming wafer supply and constraining DRAM production.

items.title: A year of fighting scrapers on my 1.5 million-page website
items.title_zh: 与机器人斗争的一年：150万页网站的防爬心得
items.title_en: A Year of Fighting Bots on a 1.5-Million-Page Website
items.summary: A site owner's year-long battle against scrapers and bots, highlighting the scale of automated traffic, costs, and the tradeoffs of using Cloudflare versus alternative anti-bot measures.

items.title: New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567m over harms to children’s mental health
items.title_zh: 新墨西哥州法院裁定Meta赔偿5.67亿美元应对青少年心理健康伤害
items.title_en: New Mexico Court Orders Meta to Pay $567M Over Youth Mental Health Harms
items.summary: A New Mexico court orders Meta to pay $567 million for harms to children's mental health, highlighting increasing legal accountability for social media platforms.

items.title: Show HN: Wyzer Programming Language
items.title_zh: Wyzer：用编排式编程解决分布式死锁的新语言
items.title_en: Wyzer: New Language Targets Distributed Deadlocks with Choreographic Programming
items.summary: Wyzer is a new statically typed, compiled, resource-oriented programming language that aims to provide distributed safety via choreographic programming and introduces a novel memory model, drawing on academic ideas to address limitations in Rust-like systems.

items.title_en: Gemini's Struggles Boost Google Cloud Short-Term
items.summary: Analyzes how Gemini's struggles are paradoxically driving short-term gains for Google Cloud Platform.

items.title: What is currently considered the theoretically optimal quantization bit-width for LLMs? [D]
items.title_zh: LLM量化位宽存在理论最优吗？
items.title_en: Is There a Theoretical Sweet Spot for LLM Quantization Bit-Width?
items.summary: Asks whether current research suggests a theoretical or empirical sweet-spot for LLM quantization bit-width when maximizing capability under a fixed memory budget, e.g., comparing 2-bit 70B vs. 4-bit 35B models.
